sub6002: It was a very lengthy story but generally it was about a woman who had split up with her boyfriend 30 days ago.
He was called Adam and it was a big struggle for her trying to get over him.
but there was a potential new love interest called Ryan who works at Starbucks.
She sees Adam on Tinder and wants to swipe right but can't for no apparent reason.
She confronts him about it but mistakes his cousin for his new girlfriend.
She meets up with Adam at the coffee shop they usually go to and she recollects all the wonderful times they met there during their 2 years together.
She flirts with Ryan the new barista.
She remembers playing the piano with Adam in her bedroom.
He is very rude to Ryan about Ryan spilling some coffee on his shirt and she remembers how he could be an idiot sometimes.
Eventually she recollects all the good things about the relationship over a box of keepsakes but realizes she must move on with her life with help from her friend Lex.
She plays the piano again by herself.
sub6012: The story starts with an alarm sound going and the person which we are seeing from the perspective waking up.
As she wakes up and moves her hair from the side of her view she reaches for her phone and sees that today marks the 30 day from the day she has broken up with her boyfriend.
At this point the story prompts to select to snooze the alarm off.

After this she feels something on her leg and she scoots away as the prompt demands and after this action she notices the bear plush from Adam and the old piano in the dark corner of the room which reminds her of the time she spent with her ex-boyfriend.
After these events she retrieves her phone and opens tinder.
The guy that she first sees swipes left but after this Adam appears
Thinking if she should swipe left or right although she in her head wanted to swipe right her body instinctively swipes left.
Some time after she receives a phone call from her best friend Lex who starts the conversation by congratulating her on her first month after her break-up jokingly.
After hanging up the call Lex calls back again stating that the main character has 5 minutes to get done as she is waiting outside for her.

Unwilling to leave the house the main character doesn't do anything but soon something starts hitting on her window and as she approaches the window she sees Lex throwing something yellow into her window to hurry her up to get done for a leave.

After this event the main character quickly dresses up with something ordinary to rush into her best friend stating that she couldn't do that type of thing and saying that something like that was "vandalism".
Lex replies offering some M&M that was actually the bag that she was throwing at the window.
As her ex was allergic to peanuts the main character eats the M&M's
something that she hasn't done for two long years which was the time of her relationship.
After this Lex brings the main character inside and walks into her closet grabbing a white dress and a red dress.
After seeing these dresses the main character thinks to herself that the white dress can get dirty and looking at the red dress she starts reminding her ex-boyfriend.
Then she rushes into her best friend's car hopping in the driver seat and starts driving into her ex's house.
Arriving at the house and parking at the front the two friends see two silhouettes at the window.
Jealous and curious at the same time the main character wants to see closer and gets out of the car to do so.
Even though Lex warns her she still goes on with her idea until she realizes how much of a stalker she is and so she starts walking away from the window.
As she is doing so she hears a crack sound and realizes that she just broke a gnome that was offered to Adam by her grandma in a christmas.
After this Adam and a mysterious girl appear at the front door.
In panic after seeing them the main character starts confronting her ex by stating that he shouldn't be already with some Tinder girl as they just have broken up.
The mysterious girl reveals herself to be Adam's cousin from New York and then goes to her van and drives away.
Embarrassed with what just happened the main character remains silent until Adam invites her for coffee.
In spite of initially being reluctant to the invite and even refusing it they end up going together to drink coffee.
Already in the car the main character starts to think about their relationship until they arrive at her regular coffee shop named Firefly.
As per usual Adam goes to sit at their usual table and the name character goes to order their drinks.

As she is going to order the drinks somebody touches her and when she sees who is she recognizes an old classmate from communication class that is actually asking her to take a photo of him and a girl that probably is his girlfriend.
Although initially it was supposed to be a photo the guy asks instead of a photo for it to be a video.
After the record starts the man reaches to a ukelele and starts singing to her girlfriend who at this time is very surprised with what is happening.
In the middle of the video the main character notices a pug scratching at the door and reaches to open it up.
After opening the door the pug goes directly to the man and delivers a ring that he puts into the finger of her newly fiancee it seems.
After this event the main character goes on to order the drinks and notices the new barista which she notices is called Ryan as stated per his name tag.
As the barista isn't noticing her she simulates a cough to get his attention and then order two daily specials.

After getting her order Ryan says that she didn't have a face that wanted a daily special. Annoyed with his remark the main character asks for two lattes instead and then the barista goes on to say "two special of the day it is' '.
After the main character goes on to sit at the table and after a couple times of silence Adam reaches his famous deck of cards for them to play their usual guessing card game.

The main character doesn't want to play but Adam insists while guessing "The Ace of Spades' ' as he grabs a card it is revealed to be the queen of hearts and he goes on to remark "a queen of hearts for the queen of abstention".
After this event, the main character says "I've missed you '' and Adam replies with an exhale which leaves the main character in panic as it is the same as saying the feeling isn't the same for him.
Shortly after Ryan arrives with the drinks and puts her drink on the table first.
At the same moment another barista is entering the coffee shop.
After making eye contact with the main character Ryan goes on to put the drink on Adam but in doing so the drink spills over Adam's shirt.

In consequence Adam starts verbally attacking Ryan and the main character starts noticing that she only has ever seen the good on Adam during their relationship and has never given much importance to the negative side of him.
Adam gets his jacket and states that he "has to get clean".
After asking the main character if she needs a ride (to which she says that it isn't needed as she will give Lex a call) Adam leaves.
After this the main character leaves too and as she is leaving she sees the newly soon to be wed couple and once again congratulates them.
The woman hugs her and states that the guys is the fifth boyfriend and that it will "get better".
Hearing this the main character replies "I hope so".
After the main character (Emily) goes to Lex house and rings the bell.
Luckily Lex answers to the door and grabs her into her room.
Lex starts applying large quantities of make-up to Emily stating that they will go to a frat party.
Arriving at the frat party Lex approaches a girl group and out of nowhere a girl from that group approaches Emily.
This girl starts by calling Emily by "Adam girlfriend" to which Emily replies with a "Ex".
After hearing this the random girl goes onto reveal that Lex said that she never liked to see Emily with Adam.
After hearing this remark Emily goes in search of Lex and applies herself to play a game of charades with Lex the queen of charades.
In the game Emily draws the card of the "snake" which she remarks as something ironic giving the situation.
After Lex gets the correct answer to the charade Emily drags Lex into another room and starts questioning her about the secret that was just revealed to her.
After insisting Lex confirms the secret saying that Emily deserved better and then goes on to signal Emily to a guy staring at the stars.
Seeing this guy Emily realizes that he is Ryan from Firefly and starts approaching him.
As she is getting close she gets some steps away and jokingly remarks Ryan record of spilling drinks.
Smiling at Emily remark Ryan says that he was new that it was hard work and most important he didn't like guys that make girls cry.
Noticing that what Ryan did at the Firefly was on purpose they start a conversation.
Emily states that their long conversation was much fun and she hasn't smiled so much in a while.
At some moment Emily giggles so much that she had to get support to stand up and at this moment Ryan and Emily hands touch.
Scared of starting something new Emily starts getting away from Ryan stating that now she isn't prepared for a new relationship and that she needs to "focus on healing".
After this Emily drags Lex into her house, puts Lex in the coach and goes to her room where she shuts the door.
In her room Emily goes to her closet and reaches to a box on the top shelf.

The box is filled with things from her past relationship with Adam and as she is reminding herself of some moments she starts to realize that she needs to make a choice: to be sad or to move along to a happy life.
As she is making her choice she goes onto put the box back into the shelf and goes to sit at the piano.
After a long time she starts playing the piano that is covered in dust from the last weeks remembering that she needs to move on to a happy life and leave the sadness behind.
As the clock is marking eleven fifty-nine Emily changes her mentality to a brand new day and a brand new life for her. The story ends at this point.
